title: Subsets Divisible by 5 - Answer Guessing
full_prompt: Create a Manim scene named `AnswerGuess` using ManimGL. The scene should present a combinatorics puzzle: 'Find the number of subsets of {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, ..., 2,000}, the sum of whose elements is divisible by 5'. First, display the question title at the top of the screen. The set {1, 2, 3, ..., 2000} should be formatted nicely with custom brackets and commas, colored in blue. Next, display the total number of subsets, which is 2^{2,000}, positioned below the title. Implement helper functions: `get_question_title()` to format the question text and replace the static set text with a dynamically generated set representation; `get_set_tex(values)` to generate a formatted set representation with curly braces, integers, commas, and ellipses for large sets; `set_tex_transform(set_1, set_2)` to animate the transformation from one set representation to another, matching identical elements and fading in new ones; and `massive_int(num)` to format a massive integer (like 2^{2000} expanded) into a grid of digits with commas. In the `construct` method of `AnswerGuess` (which inherits from `InteractiveScene`), display the title, show the total number of subsets, and then transition to showing a massive integer representation of 2^{2000} or a similar large number to emphasize the scale of the problem.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing helper functions like get_set_tex or massive_int
common_failure_modes.note: The scene relies heavily on custom formatting helpers defined outside the class.
Using standard arrange instead of arrange_in_grid can cause layout overflow.
